anti_restart_rule: A new user 'continua' starts from the last durable progress token. It MUST NOT reopen a route closed for repeated failure unless live authority or prerequisites materially changed.
authority_rule: Live scientific pointer and live branch/WAL outrank main-governance cached counts and all memory.

deterministic_decision_table.do: RESET retry counters and continue from new state
ONE corrected retry is permitted only if arguments or method materially change
deterministic_decision_table.when: first failure fingerprint on current route

deterministic_decision_table.do: CLOSE route for this turn; checkpoint evidence; switch to an independent valid route
deterministic_decision_table.when: same failure fingerprint occurs second time
same exact tool call would be attempted a third time without progress

deterministic_decision_table.do: FORCE route change; no further diagnosis on that path
deterministic_decision_table.when: 4 consecutive tool events create no durable or computational progress

deterministic_decision_table.do: STOP exploratory work; persist exact checkpoint and perform only the next independent executable action if available
deterministic_decision_table.when: 8 total no-progress tool events occur in a turn

deterministic_decision_table.do: EXECUTE it; do not ask the user to say continue again
deterministic_decision_table.when: authorized next action exists and its prerequisites are present

deterministic_decision_table.do: record BLOCKED_BY_INFRASTRUCTURE with searched locations and continue an orthogonal valid lane; never loop recovery
deterministic_decision_table.when: required prerequisite is genuinely absent after one bounded recovery pass

failure_fingerprint: normalized error/status + missing dependency + authoritative path; cosmetic message changes do not reset retry counters.
forbidden: Open a paid service merely to avoid a chat reasoning loop
Restart a closed recovery path because the user says continue
Turn REPORTADO or INFERIDO evidence into VERIFICADO
Touch scientific results merely to validate this control policy
objective: Prevent the assistant from consuming a turn by repeating a non-progressing recovery/execution path and then restarting the same path after user interruption.

counts_as_progress: Authenticated authority SHA or branch tip changes because a legitimate CAS commit was published
A frozen task/shard becomes independently verified and its receipt hash is new
A durable checkpoint/pointer/WAL is advanced and remote readback passes
A blocker is resolved by new evidence that changes the executable next action
does_not_count: Repeating the same fetch/search/open/find with materially identical arguments
Receiving the same error/failure fingerprint again
Re-reading unchanged authority without executing the next action
Creating another plan/helper/README that does not change executable state
Explaining the blockage without checkpointing or switching route

route_identity: objective + live authority SHA + scientific stage + action family; changing wording or helper filenames does not create a new route.
scope: All active ChatGPT turns in Trading algoritmico using QROS/RISE; controls reasoning/tool-loop behavior only.
self_application: This policy applies to recovery, GitHub, file retrieval, data materialization, backtests, validation, persistence and anti-stall debugging itself.
